# Crownwood Chemicals

> Texas supplier of road and soil products and provider of commercial and municipal construction services.

## Road Building Products

Crownwood carries the PCT Fastphalt road line and helps customers confirm application rates, quantities, availability, and current technical documents for each project.

- [All PCT Road Building Products](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/road-building-products)
- [Dust Defeater](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/dust-defeater) - cold-pour dust control for gravel and dirt roads
- [PHPM-50 / FP PrimePatch](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/phpm-50) - no-heat tack membrane for patching and overlays
- [Banana Slide](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/banana-slide) - asphalt equipment release agent
- [FP Blacktrac](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/fp-blacktrac) - sprayable sealer for low-volume hot-mix roads
- [Rumbleguard](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/rumbleguard) - preventive treatment for rumble strips
- [Eco Black / COS-50](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/eco-black) - no-heat sealer for low-speed asphalt and chip seal
- [BAM](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/bam) - bonding adhesive material for injection and stockpile patching
- [Monkey Business](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/monkey-business) - D-limonene asphalt equipment cleaner

## Other Products

- [Permabase](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/permabase) - soil-treatment product for suitable cohesive soils
- [Permabase Black](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/permabase-black) - tinted soil treatment for selected low-speed surfaces
- [MeltDown MR-1](https://crownwoodchemicals.com/chemicals/meltdown) - soy-based asphalt remover and release treatment
